title: WorldState / DecisionContext
description: A reconstructed match state at one instant (README SS14, Handoff SS12) plus the deciding team's limited observation/belief (DECISION-004: the AI must not read enemy positions it cannot observe). The top-level object is a DecisionContext: ground-truth WorldState + which team is deciding + that team's BeliefState. This is the exact input shape consumed by the Action Generator / Decision Debugger (PV-3/PV-4). For real matches, tick-accurate WorldState is FUTURE; the scenario samples here are SYNTHETIC (provenance.synthetic=true).

contextId.description: Stable id for this decision context / scenario.

scenarioRef.description: Which Handoff SS20 scenario (e.g. 'scenario-07-operator-save') this illustrates, if any.

decidingTeamIdx.description: Which team's decision this context is framed for.

belief.description: The deciding team's observation-derived knowledge. Enemy positions here are observed/inferred only, never copied from worldState truth.

timeUntilDetonationMs.description: ms remaining on the spike timer when planted (SPIKE_SECONDS=45000 at plant).

playerState.description: One player's full true state (Handoff SS12.2 / README SS14.1 PlayerState).

worldState.description: Ground-truth match state at an instant.

matchId.description: May be a synthetic id; check provenance.synthetic.

timeRemainingMs.description: ms remaining in the current phase. In the combat phase this counts down from 100000; after plant the spike timer governs.

roundPhase.description: buy=barriers up; round=combat pre-plant; post_plant=spike planted.

matchScore.description: Rounds won so far [team0, team1]. Needed for save/matchpoint reasoning (Handoff SS20.9).

plantZones.description: Optional convenience hint: valid spike-plant areas keyed by site letter, as a representative point in minimapUnits. Used to test plant feasibility (Handoff SS20.05). The authoritative plant-zone geometry is owned by the Spatial agent (datasets/spatial/); this is a synthetic placeholder.

observedEnemy.description: An enemy the deciding team currently sees or recently saw.

lastSeenMsAgo.description: ms since last observed; information decays (README SS17.3).

beliefState.description: Deciding team's knowledge (README SS14.2 / Handoff SS12.4). Separate from worldState truth so action generation can be tested under partial observation.

knownEnemyAliveCount.description: How many enemies the team believes are alive (may be certain from kill feed).

tacticalHypotheses.description: Inferred enemy intents with uncertainty (Handoff SS22.2 — intent is not observable).
